title: Phantom Trading Co. — Regime Classification Standard v1
description: Canonical regime classification schema. All agents MUST consume regime from GET /api/market/regime, NOT compute their own. Aligns with MarketRegime and RegimeClassification in src/types/trading.ts.

canonicalSource.rule: ALL agents MUST use this endpoint for regime classification. Agent-computed ADX values are NOT authoritative and MUST NOT be used for pipeline decisions. If the API is unavailable, use 'unknown' regime — never guess.

trending_up.definition: ADX > 30 AND trendStrength > 0.01 (high confidence), OR ADX 20-30 AND trendStrength > 0.005 (transitional, 0.5 confidence)
trending_up.description: Confirmed uptrend. EMA Ribbon entries on pullbacks to EMA(21). Full position sizing.

trending_down.definition: ADX > 30 AND trendStrength < -0.01 (high confidence), OR ADX 20-30 AND trendStrength < -0.005 (transitional, 0.5 confidence)
trending_down.description: Confirmed downtrend. EMA Ribbon short entries. Full position sizing.

ranging.description: No directional bias. LSR on equal high/low sweeps. FRC if funding conditions met. Reduced sizing.

volatile.description: High volatility environment. EFR and FRC active. Reduced sizing due to whipsaw risk.

unknown.definition: Cannot classify — insufficient data or API unavailable
unknown.description: No trading in unknown regime. Wait for classification.

transition.note: ADX 20-30 is a transition zone. Classifier assigns 0.5 confidence in this zone. Note: hysteresis is DOCUMENTED here but NOT yet implemented in regime-classifier.ts — classifier re-classifies fresh each call.

transitional.note: ADX 20-30 can classify as trending with 0.5 confidence if trendStrength exceeds 0.005. This is by design — weak trends get low confidence.

computation.trendDirection: Determined by +DI vs -DI from ADX computation. trendStrength = (+DI - -DI) / (+DI + -DI)

hysteresis.rule: Once a regime is classified, it persists until the OPPOSITE threshold is crossed. This prevents flip-flopping at boundaries.
hysteresis.example: If regime is 'trending_up' (ADX 27), it stays 'trending_up' until ADX drops below 20 (not 25). ADX 24 in a previously trending regime = still trending.

computation.candleRequirement: Minimum 100 candles for reliable ADX computation. 50-candle window produces noisy classifications.

strategyRouting.rule: The regime router is the ONLY authority for strategy activation. No agent may activate a strategy outside its designated regimes.

registeredStrategies.note: Alt-specific EFR. Operates on per-symbol regime, not BTC regime.

agentInstructions.scannerMonitor: Use GET /api/market/regime for each pair before checking strategy conditions. Include regime and regimeSource in all scan outputs.
agentInstructions.strategyArchitect: Design strategies with explicit regime requirements. Reference this schema's regime definitions.
agentInstructions.headOfTrading: Validate that all signals include regime from the canonical source before forwarding to execution.
agentInstructions.executionTrader: Reject any signal where regimeSource is 'agent-computed' unless API is confirmed down.
agentInstructions.microstructureAnalyst: Include regime in execution feasibility assessments — volatile regimes need wider slippage estimates.

adxDiscrepancy_2026_03_08.description: Strategy Architect computed BTC ADX 23.8, CEO reported 27.4. Likely cause: different candle windows or Wilder smoothing seed.
adxDiscrepancy_2026_03_08.resolution: This schema mandates using the API endpoint as the single source of truth. Agent-computed values are for analysis only, never for pipeline decisions.
adxDiscrepancy_2026_03_08.practicalImpact: None at time of discrepancy — no EMA Ribbon entry conditions were met regardless of which ADX value was used.

schemaCodeDiscrepancy_2026_03_08.description: Schema v1.0 documented trending threshold as ADX > 25. Actual code in src/lib/market/regime-classifier.ts:149 uses ADX > 30 for high-confidence trending, with ADX 20-30 as a transitional zone (0.5 confidence). Identified by Meta-Strategist HB12.
schemaCodeDiscrepancy_2026_03_08.resolution: Schema corrected by CEO (silver-falcon) to match code. Trending definitions now reflect ADX > 30 (strong) and ADX 20-30 (transitional). Transition zone note updated. Hysteresis documented as NOT YET implemented.
